description: This file is a shell script containing tests and utilities for the Git upload-pack service, specifically testing ref-in-want behavior and fetch negotiations.

methods.name: get_actual_refs
methods.description: Extracts the refs from the output, processing 'wanted-refs' lines and filtering out certain lines.

methods.name: get_actual_commits
methods.description: Parses and sorts commit objects from the output stream.

methods.name: check_output
methods.description: Runs ref and commit extraction functions and compares their output to expected values.

methods.name: write_command
methods.description: Prints a command with optional object-format, used in fetch command sequence.

methods.name: write_fetch_command
methods.description: Constructs a fetch request including want-ref, want, and have lines.

methods.name: inconsistency
methods.description: Simulates server ref inconsistencies during negotiation by modifying ref reports.
